name: Dissolving Lock Trap (CR 2)
body:
Dissolving Lock Trap
CR 2

XP 600; Type mechanical; Notice Perception DC 20; Disable Disable Device DC 20; Trigger touch; Reset none

EFFECTS

Atk +10 ranged touch; Damage 4d4 acid damage; Additional Effects Renders the lock unable to be unlocked by mundane means.

ABOUT

This trap is often used to prevent the rescue of valuable prisoners or other treasures. A dissolving lock trap has a reservoir of acid built into an oversized padlock or door lock (typically, an average lock [DC 25] or good lock [DC 30]). When a Disable Device check to open the lock fails, the reservoir bursts, spraying acid from the keyhole and destroying the lock’s internal unlocking mechanism.
